tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and lie at H≤0.48, more than 50 times shorter than the target horizon. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether delayed adaptation overwhelms the initial gain in the forecast regime.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-window observations constrain the early rise but do not reliably separate slow amplitude from slow time constant. A good pilot fit would not establish the reversal at H=24.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Every pilot row has s_grad=0, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable, and the slow response remains untested.
Finer trajectory sampling is less directly informative than a long-horizon measurement for testing the predicted sign reversal.
